fixed_global_transition_model.name: STANDARD_LASSERRE_SUM_OF_SQUARES_LEVEL_ESCALATION
fixed_global_transition_model.semantics: Encode the 3-CNF/k-CSP as the standard 0-1 polynomial/SDP relaxation and obtain exact negative authority only when a Lasserre/Sum-of-Squares level refutes feasibility; levels are increased within the standard hierarchy.
fixed_global_transition_model.globality: The state uses global moment/consistency constraints and is not merely bounded-local clause propagation.
fixed_global_transition_model.standard_level_cost: For a k-CSP with poly(n) constraints, level r can be optimized in time n^{O(r)} in the formulation used by the cited paper.

published_theorem.author: Grant Schoenebeck
published_theorem.title: Linear Level Lasserre Lower Bounds for Certain k-CSPs
published_theorem.statement_used: For every k >= 3, even Omega(n) levels of the Lasserre hierarchy cannot disprove random k-CSP instances over predicate types implied by k-XOR, including k-SAT and k-XOR. In particular, random 3-SAT instances in the covered regime survive a linear number of hierarchy levels despite being globally unsatisfiable with high probability.
published_theorem.cost_statement_used: The paper states that level r of Lasserre for a k-CSP with poly(n) constraints can be optimized in time n^{O(r)}.

derived_TRUMP_barrier.claim: The standard Lasserre/SoS level-escalation route cannot serve as a universal polynomial-time exact TRUMP transition law for arbitrary 3-CNF.
reason: There are unsatisfiable random 3-SAT instances for which every hierarchy level below a linear threshold fails to refute satisfiability.
Therefore any exact use of this standard route must, on those instances, escalate to linear-order level before obtaining negative authority.
The standard generic optimization cost n^{O(r)} becomes n^{Omega(n)} at linear r, violating L3 charged polynomial work and hence the Legend polynomial-runtime target.
The failure is not local blindness: the hierarchy is global, but the proof/relaxation degree required for exactness grows too far.

dead_zone_mapping.meaning: A globally informed relaxation can still contain a semantic dead zone: pseudo-distributions/moment data remain feasible even when no Boolean assignment exists.

what_is_not_proved: No lower bound is claimed for arbitrary semidefinite algorithms outside the fixed standard Lasserre/SoS hierarchy route.
No lower bound is claimed for every individual 3-CNF instance.
The result does not prove that global information is insufficient in principle; it blocks this precise global relaxation architecture as an easier universal route.

next_admissible_math.question: After proof-search, bounded-local propagation, full-function compilation, and standard global SoS/Lasserre escalation are blocked as easier universal routes, can TRUMP specify a global exact transition whose semantics are not merely proof search or relaxation feasibility and prove total polynomial charged work directly?
forbidden: unbounded level escalation hidden inside one macrostep
renaming known proof/relaxation machines without changing their mathematical semantics
